description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Amendment to LKAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statments and LKAS 8 - Accounting Policies
categorisation: The gazette content involves the publication of amendments to accounting standards (LKAS 1 and LKAS 8) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes regulatory matters and legal framework updates, specifically falling under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements for financial reporting.
